title: Kangaroo - FEVM Data Dao Starter Kit
tagline: The easiest way to create a Data DAO on FVM
description: Data DAOs are the best way to goven file storage in a decentralized way. Currently there is no easy way to get started with having a Data DAO for your organization. Kangaroo solves this in a easy way. DAOs can use this starter kit to deploy their own DataDAO on FVM and incentivize Storage Providers to store files with native governace tokens made on FEVM
how_its_made: FEVM Limitations were fun to get over. DealMaking and verifying APIs not straight forward to implement. Building ERC20 tokens from scratch was fun as well
